QUOTE: The threading layer itself (`library/threading.c`) only supplies the pthread or user-supplied implementation behind `mbedtls_mutex_lock/unlock`. ... "the library starts no threads"

VERDICT: HIT

WHY: The answer says the library starts no threads, and that `library/threading.c` supplies the mutex abstraction (`mbedtls_mutex_lock/unlock`) used by callers when threading is enabled.
